_note: Greenfield scenario for the unattended pipeline batch. All data is FICTIONAL sample data; no client data, code or vendor names. G1: API + Postgres.
feature: Course section enrollment API backed by Postgres: catalog search, enroll and drop with seat capacity and waitlist
problem: Students and the advising front end need a reliable enrollment API; today seat counts drift because enrollment is not transactional and two students can take the last seat
users: Student (through a front end that calls the API)
goals: Schema as plain SQL migration files (numbered, applied in order by a small script): terms, courses, sections (capacity), students, enrollments (status enrolled|waitlisted|dropped, created_at), with foreign keys, unique (student, section) for active rows and the indexes the queries need
Seed script with fictional data: 1 term, 40 courses, 80 sections, 300 students
GET /api/sections?term=&q=&limit=&cursor= : search sections by course code or title, keyset pagination, limit capped at 100, returns seats_taken and seats_left

POST /api/enrollments {student_id, section_id}: enrolls when a seat is free, otherwise waitlists; never oversells under concurrent requests (row lock or equivalent in one transaction); 409 when already enrolled or waitlisted
DELETE /api/enrollments/:id : drops; the earliest waitlisted student is promoted in the same transaction
GET /api/sections/:id/roster : enrolled then waitlisted students in order
Every request body and query string validated with zod; errors return {error:{code,message}} with 400/404/409, never a stack trace; SQL is parameterised only
A small home page at / that documents the endpoints and shows live counts (styled, readable on a phone)

metrics.name: Oversell under concurrency
metrics.target: 0: 50 concurrent enrolls into a 10-seat section give exactly 10 enrolled and 40 waitlisted

constraints: Next.js App Router route handlers with TypeScript and the `pg` package; no ORM

Integration tests run with `npm test` against the Postgres at the DATABASE_URL environment variable (it is set when tests run); each test file creates its own schema, applies the migrations into it and drops it afterwards
Unit tests for validation and pure logic need no database

phases.name: v1
scope: Integration tests for every endpoint including the 50-concurrent-enrollment test
